about: Role pairs for criterion 3 and the five quantize roles for criterion 4, as sRGB [r, g, b]. series_red and series_green: as seen 0.370 apart in OKLab, under Machado et al. 2009 deuteranopia (severity 100, applied in linear sRGB) 0.020 apart. series_blue and series_orange: at least 0.25 apart as seen and under each of the three simulations. Every role used with the clean look (series_*, candle_*) lies at least 0.16 from each of its status colors, past its 0.10 status distance. The tests recompute the criterion's distances before they use a pair.
